en.bdb: Teaching from madder Rubia munjista and safflower-

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਦਾ ਕਚਾ ਪਕਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: ra(n)g majeeTh kasu(n)bh dhaa kachaa pakaa kit veechaare|

en.bdb: Why madder is the fast colour and safflower temporary.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਉਖਣਿ ਕਢੀਐ ਮੂਲ ਮਜੀਠ ਜੜੀ ਜੜਤਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: dharatee ukhan kaddeeaai mool majeeTh jaRee jaRataare|

en.bdb: The roots of madder spread in earth, it is first brought out and put into the pit and is pounded with wooden pestles.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਖਲ ਮੁਹਲੇ ਕੁਟੀਐ ਪੀਹਣਿ ਪੀਸੈ ਚਕੀ ਭਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: aukhal muhale kuTeeaai peehan peesai chakee bhaare|

en.bdb: Then it is crushed into a heavy mill.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹੈ ਅਵੱਟਣੁ ਅੱਗਿ ਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: sahai ava'Tan a'g dhaa hoi piaaree milai piaare|

en.bdb: It further suffers the pain of getting boiled and decorated in water and then only it adorns (with fast colour) the clothes of the beloved.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੋਹਲੀਅਹੁ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਢਿ ਕੈ ਫੁਲੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਚਲੁੰਭ ਖਿਲਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: pohaleeahu sir kadd kai ful kasu(n)bh chalu(n)bh khilaare|

en.bdb: The safflower comes up from the upper portion of the thorny weed Carthamus tinctoria and yields its deep colour.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਟ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਦੇ ਰੰਗੀਐ ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਹ ਚਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: khaT turasee dhe ra(n)geeaai kapaT saneh rahai dheh chaare|

en.bdb: Adding tart in it, the clothes are dyed and they remain dyed only for a few days.
The lowly born utimately wins and the so-called high up gets defeated.
